content:
TOMISLAV MESARIĆ
Butcher | Meat Counter Assistant
Ulica Lipa 12, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia | +385 1 555 0142 | tomislav.mesaric@example.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Qualified butcher with experience in carcass breakdown, boning, trimming, portioning and customer service in a family butcher shop and a market meat counter. Skilled in fresh sausage production, FIFO stock rotation and HACCP checks, including temperature and hygiene records. Experienced in training apprentices.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Butcher | Mesnica Kod Ante (family butcher shop), Zagreb
2019–Present
- Break down 2–3 beef forequarters and 10–12 pork sides per week; bone, trim and portion meat for the counter.
- Produce around 40 kg of fresh sausages per week in the busy season, including ćevapi, kobasice, chipolata and lamb merguez.
- Developed the shop’s lamb merguez recipe and adjusted the ćevapi mix to 70% beef and 30% lamb following customer feedback; the ćevapi won second place at the 2023 Zagreb County craft meat fair.
- Rotate cold-room stock each morning using FIFO, placing the oldest stock at the front.
- Record cold-room (0–4 °C) and display-counter temperature checks twice daily.
- Serve around 120 customers on Saturdays, advising on cuts, quantities and cooking times.
- Train two apprentices in knife handling and cleaning routines.
- Prepare whole lambs and suckling pigs for spit-roasting events, including ordering, butchering, seasoning and delivery.
- Ran a six-week dry-ageing trial of beef ribs, recording temperature and weight loss; the shop now sells dry-aged rib by pre-order.

Counter Assistant | Tržnica Dolac meat hall stall, Zagreb
2015–2019
- Served customers, weighed and priced orders, operated the till and completed cash-up.
- Cleaned and sanitised slicers, mincers, the counter and floor drain at closing.
- Wrote a one-page closing and cleaning checklist following a hygiene inspection remark; it remains in use at the stall.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATES
Vocational Certificate: Butcher (3-year programme) | Food Trades School Zagreb, 2015
HACCP Basic Food Hygiene Certificate | 2021; renewed 2024

SKILLS
Carcass breakdown: beef, pork and lamb | Boning, trimming and portioning | Fresh sausage making | FIFO stock rotation | HACCP temperature and hygiene checks | Knife sharpening | Mincer and bandsaw operation | Customer service and product advice | Cash handling | Cleaning and sanitising equipment

LANGUAGES
Croatian (native) | English (good) | German (basic)


Dear FreshCart Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant position at your Zagreb-Jarun store. I am a qualified butcher with experience in carcass breakdown and meat-counter service, along with HACCP knowledge and daily FIFO stock rotation.

In my current role at Mesnica Kod Ante, I break down beef and pork, bone and portion meat for the counter, and record temperature checks twice daily. I serve around 120 customers on Saturdays, advising them on cuts, quantities and cooking times. I also make fresh sausages and train apprentices in knife handling and cleaning routines. Previously, at the Tržnica Dolac meat stall, I weighed and priced orders, operated the till and kept equipment and work areas clean and sanitised.

FreshCart’s emphasis on fresh local food and knowledgeable, helpful counter staff appeals to me. I would bring practical butchery experience, reliable stock rotation and careful attention to hygiene and food-safety records to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience could contribute to the meat counter at your Zagreb-Jarun store.

Kind regards,
Tomislav Mesarić

critique.content_quality_feedback: The cover letter is concise, professional, and well targeted to the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant role. It clearly connects the candidate’s current butchery work and previous counter-assistant experience to customer service, meat preparation, temperature checks, FIFO rotation, sausage production, training, till operation, and sanitation. The tone is appropriate and the letter avoids unsupported claims. It could be slightly stronger by explicitly naming the completed butcher qualification and the candidate’s total relevant experience, rather than relying mainly on the phrase “qualified butcher.”
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The letter uses a simple, ATS-friendly structure with standard paragraphs, no problematic tables, graphics, headers, or unusual formatting. It includes important matching terms such as “Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant,” “carcass breakdown,” “HACCP,” “FIFO,” “temperature checks,” “fresh sausages,” “customer service,” “till,” and “cleaned and sanitised.” ATS and AI screening probability is high because the content is directly relevant and truthful. Minor keyword coverage could improve by explicitly including “completed butcher training,” “portion,” “stock rotation,” and “food-safety records” in more direct wording. The letter appropriately does not claim supermarket, self-service packaging, labelling-scale, or forklift experience that the candidate does not have.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: Alignment is very strong. The document shows the must-have requirements through the candidate’s completed butcher qualification, more than two years of meat-counter experience, and HACCP-related temperature and hygiene checks. It also addresses core duties including cutting, boning, portioning, customer advice, FIFO stock rotation, counter hygiene, and food-safety records. The reference to fresh local food and knowledgeable, helpful counter service aligns with FreshCart’s stated priorities and “Ask the counter” approach. The candidate’s material shows no forklift licence, so that nice-to-have is a gap rather than a document defect. The letter does not claim experience with supermarket self-service shelves, tray sealers, labelling scales, or pallet forklifts, which is appropriately truthful.
critique.improvement_instructions:
MINOR ENHANCEMENT — In the opening paragraph, change “I am a qualified butcher with experience in carcass breakdown and meat-counter service, along with HACCP knowledge and daily FIFO stock rotation” to “I completed a three-year vocational butcher programme in 2015 and have nine years of experience in butchery and meat-counter service, including carcass breakdown, portioning, HACCP temperature and hygiene checks, and daily FIFO stock rotation.” This makes the completed training and experience duration explicit for both ATS and recruiters.

MINOR ENHANCEMENT — In the second paragraph, change “I break down beef and pork, bone and portion meat for the counter” to “I break down beef, pork and lamb, bone, trim and portion fresh meat for the service counter.” This more closely reflects the candidate’s documented experience and uses the job advertisement’s “fresh meat,” “portion,” and “service counter” terminology.

MINOR ENHANCEMENT — In the final body paragraph, change “reliable stock rotation and careful attention to hygiene and food-safety records” to “reliable FIFO stock rotation and careful completion of temperature and hygiene records.” This uses the exact operational language supported by the candidate’s experience and makes the HACCP-related recordkeeping contribution more concrete.
critique.critical_issues:
Claims the sources (the candidate's own material; for the employer, the job ad and company research) do not support:
- "advising them on ... quantities"

critique.content_quality_feedback: The cover letter is concise, professional, and well targeted to the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant role. It clearly establishes the candidate’s completed butcher training, nine years of relevant experience, carcass breakdown, customer service, sausage production, FIFO rotation, and HACCP recordkeeping. The examples are credible and supported by the candidate information. The structure is easy to follow, with a strong opening, relevant evidence from both roles, and a professional closing. It could be marginally stronger by using a few more of the employer’s exact terms and by making the connection to FreshCart’s customer-service priorities slightly more specific.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: ATS compatibility is strong for a cover letter. The document uses standard headings-free letter formatting, readable paragraphs, conventional punctuation, and relevant keywords including butcher, meat counter, carcass breakdown, portioning, HACCP, temperature checks, hygiene checks, FIFO, fresh sausages, customer service, and till operation. It is highly likely to be parsed correctly and should have a high AI-screening probability because the experience directly matches the stated must-have requirements. The letter does not claim unsupported supermarket, self-service packaging, tray-sealer, or forklift experience. A minor enhancement would be to repeat the exact role wording “Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant” in the body and use “fresh meat” and “customer advice” terminology closer to the advertisement.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The document aligns very well with the role. Completed butcher training and more than two years of meat-counter experience are shown, as is HACCP knowledge. The letter also addresses the main duties: cutting and portioning fresh meat, advising customers on cuts and cooking times, FIFO rotation, and recording temperature and hygiene checks. It reflects FreshCart’s stated culture through references to fresh local food, knowledgeable counter staff, and careful hygiene and stock practices. The candidate does not hold a forklift licence, which is a stated nice-to-have gap rather than a document defect. The letter also does not claim experience with supermarket self-service packaging or tray-sealing equipment, which is appropriately truthful.
critique.improvement_instructions:
MINOR ENHANCEMENT: In the third paragraph, change “FreshCart’s emphasis on fresh local food and knowledgeable, helpful counter staff appeals to me” to “FreshCart’s focus on fresh, locally sourced food and knowledgeable, helpful counter service appeals to me.” This more closely reflects the advertisement’s wording while remaining fully supported by the job description.

MINOR ENHANCEMENT: In the second paragraph, change “break down beef, pork and lamb, bone, trim and portion fresh meat for the service counter” to “break down beef, pork and lamb carcasses, bone, trim and portion fresh meat for the service counter.” This adds the exact relevant keyword “carcasses,” which is supported by the candidate’s experience and improves alignment with the butcher requirement.

MINOR ENHANCEMENT: In the final paragraph, change “contribute to the meat counter at your Zagreb-Jarun store” to “contribute to the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant team at your Zagreb-Jarun store.” This repeats the exact job title for slightly stronger ATS and recruiter alignment.
critique.critical_issues:
Claims the sources (the candidate's own material; for the employer, the job ad and company research) do not support:
- "HACCP temperature and hygiene checks"
- "temperature and hygiene records"
